summary: Hide Estimated Onboarding Date on Account and Map from Lead to Opportunity

description.raw: As an MRD I want the  Estimated Onboarding Date  field to be hidden from all Account page layouts So that it is only used during the Lead-to-Opportunity process and not visible or editable once the Account is created, while still ensuring the value carries over automatically from Lead to Opportunity. Scenario 1: Estimated Onboarding Date hidden from all Account page layouts   Given an Account record is displayed   When any user views or edits an Account   Then the "Estimated_Onboarding_Date__c" field should not appear on the page layout   And users should not be able to view or edit this field on any Account record type Scenario 2: Estimated Onboarding Date maps from Lead to Opportunity   Given a Lead record has a value in the "Estimated_Onboarding_Date__c" field   When the Lead is converted to an Opportunity   Then the "Estimated_Onboarding_Date__c" field on the Opportunity should automatically populate with the same value from the Lead Scenario 3: No mapping to Account during conversion   Given a Lead is converted   When the system creates the related Account record   Then the "Estimated_Onboarding_Date__c" field should not populate or appear on the Account
